name: Propstep Aranya
tagline: 62 garden villas on 18 acres, ten minutes from the airport.
summary: Low-density 4 and 5 BHK villas arranged around a restored lake and three acres of native woodland.
description: Aranya — Sanskrit for forest — is planned around what was already here: a seasonal lake, more than 400 mature trees and the long, low evening light of North Bengaluru. Just 62 villas sit on 18 acres, each with a private garden, a double-height living room and a courtyard that draws daylight through the centre of the house.

The landscape uses only native and climate-adapted species. Rainwater harvesting, solar-assisted common areas and a sewage treatment plant sized for full reuse keep running costs low for the long term, and the whole community is designed to be walked, not driven.

name: Propstep Lakeshore
tagline: Lake-facing sky residences, thirty-four floors above Hebbal.
summary: Three residences a floor, each with a 10 ft deep wraparound deck over Hebbal lake.
description: Two slender towers, three residences a floor, and a view that nothing will build in front of: 150 acres of protected lake to the west and the city skyline to the south. Lakeshore is designed for people who want the convenience of Hebbal — ten minutes to Manyata, a straight run to the airport — without living at street level.

Every home has its own lift lobby, a 10 ft deep wraparound deck and floor-to-ceiling glazing with high-performance glass that keeps the heat out. The 33rd-floor Sky Club has an infinity-edge pool, a residents' lounge and a private dining room with the best sunset in North Bengaluru.

name: Propstep Meridian
tagline: Light-filled 2 & 3 BHK homes on Sarjapur Road's quieter side.
summary: Every home is a corner home, with light and cross-ventilation on two sides.
description: Meridian is planned for how Sarjapur Road actually lives: short school runs, long work days and weekends that start at the clubhouse. Six towers are arranged around a one-acre central park, so every living room looks onto green rather than into a neighbour's window.

We designed the floor plates so that every home is a corner home — light on two sides, genuine cross-ventilation and no shared walls across the corridor. Vehicles stay below ground, leaving the entire podium to people.

name: Propstep Greenacres
tagline: Villa plots and managed farmland in the foothills of Nandi.
summary: 64 acres of title-clean land, with roads, power and water in place and ready to register today.
description: Greenacres sits where the plains start to rise towards Nandi Hills — cooler by a few degrees, greener by a long way, and 40 minutes from Hebbal on the airport road. The layout is complete: roads, underground power, water lines and street lighting are in, and plots are ready to register today.

Choose a villa plot and build to your own design (our architects can help), or buy a managed farmland parcel that our agronomy partners plant and tend for you with fruit orchards and native trees. Every title has been through a 30-year search by our legal team.

name: Propstep One
tagline: A 1.1 million sq ft workplace campus on the Outer Ring Road.
summary: 38,000 sq ft floor plates, a metro station at the gate and LEED Platinum targeted.
description: Propstep One brings a campus-grade workplace to the busiest stretch of the Outer Ring Road — two towers linked by a landscaped courtyard, a food hall, a wellness floor and a metro station on the upcoming Blue Line within 400 metres of the gate.

Large, column-light floor plates of 38,000 sq ft suit everything from a 3,000 sq ft suite to a multi-floor headquarters. The building is designed for LEED Platinum, with 100% fresh-air ventilation, rooftop solar and a target energy intensity well below the Bengaluru Grade-A average.

name: Propstep Residences
tagline: Our first address in Whitefield — handed over four months early.
summary: 312 homes, fully occupied, with resales available through Propstep Advisory.
description: Propstep Residences was our first large community, and the project that taught us what we now do on every site: publish the construction schedule, share monthly progress photos with every buyer, and never promise a date we can't beat. It was handed over in July 2023, four months ahead of the RERA-committed date.

Today it's a settled community of 312 families, ten minutes' walk from the Purple Line. The occupancy certificate is in place, the residents' association is fully handed over, and occasional resales are listed exclusively through Propstep Advisory.
